sources.title: DreamZero-SO101 — An Open World Model for the SO-101 Robot Arm
sources.snippet: DreamZero-SO101 is an open-source world-action model for the SO-101 robot arm. Given a single camera frame and a language instruction, it imagines the robot completing the task.

sources.title: GitHub - Vizuara-AI-Lab/dreamzero-so101
